import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, T;
    static List<String> gridA, gridB;
    static int[][] distFromStart = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] distToFinish = new int[30][30];
    static int[] dirsX = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dirsY = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static class FlowEdge {
        int u, v, capacity, flow;
        FlowEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
            u = a;
            v = b;
            capacity = cap;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<List<Integer>> graph;
    static List<FlowEdge> edges;
    static int[] level;
    static int[] curPtr;
    static int source, sink;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, cap));
        edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, 0));
        graph.get(u).add(edges.size() - 2);
        graph.get(v).add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean bfs_level() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        level[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && level[sink] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : graph.get(u)) {
                FlowEdge e = edges.get(id);
                if (level[e.v] == -1 && e.flow < e.capacity) {
                    level[e.v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs_block(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int i = curPtr[u]; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
            curPtr[u] = i;
            int id = graph.get(u).get(i);
            FlowEdge e = edges.get(id);
            if (level[e.v] != level[u] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs_block(e.v, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (bfs_level()) {
            Arrays.fill(curPtr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs_block(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void computeDist1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j)
                distFromStart[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        distFromStart[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dirsX[d], ny = y + dirsY[d];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && distFromStart[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && gridB.get(nx).charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    distFromStart[nx][ny] = distFromStart[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void computeDist2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j)
                distToFinish[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        distToFinish[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            if (distToFinish[x][y] >= distFromStart[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dirsX[d], ny = y + dirsY[d];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && distToFinish[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && gridA.get(nx).charAt(ny) != 'Y' && distToFinish[x][y] + 1 <= distFromStart[nx][ny]) {
                    distToFinish[nx][ny] = distToFinish[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        gridA = new ArrayList<>();
        gridB = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) gridA.add(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) gridB.add(br.readLine());

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (gridB.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    StringBuilder sb1 = new StringBuilder(gridA.get(i));
                    StringBuilder sb2 = new StringBuilder(gridB.get(i));
                    sb1.setCharAt(j, 'Y');
                    sb2.setCharAt(j, 'Y');
                    gridA.set(i, sb1.toString());
                    gridB.set(i, sb2.toString());
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        computeDist1(zx, zy);

        int nodes = 2 * n * n + 2;
        graph = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; ++i) graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        level = new int[nodes];
        curPtr = new int[nodes];
        source = 0;
        sink = nodes - 1;
        edges = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (gridA.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int u = i * n + j + 1;
                int v = n * n + u;
                int cap1 = gridA.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                int cap2 = gridB.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                addEdge(source, u, cap1);
                addEdge(v, sink, cap2);
                computeDist2(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                        if (gridB.get(x).charAt(y) == 'Y' || distToFinish[x][y] > T) continue;
                        addEdge(u, n * n + x * n + y + 1, cap1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
